pr_title: feat(workflow): periodic core-consistency check for workflows, versions and triggers

comments.body: The trigger query reads every row in `workflowAutomatedTrigger` and has no `"deletedAt" IS NULL` filter. The workflow and version queries above it do filter on `deletedAt IS NULL`. Deleting a workflow soft-deletes its triggers: `workflow-common.workspace-service.ts:301` calls `workflowAutomatedTriggerRepository.softDelete({ workflowId })`. The cache is built from ACTIVE core versions only (`workspace-workflow-automated-trigger-map-cache.service.ts:29-42`), so it has no entry for a soft-deleted workflow. Every soft-deleted workflow that had an automated trigger therefore lands in `tableByWorkflowId` but not in the cache. The loop at line 565 then counts it as `inTableNotCache`. This emits a permanent false-positive `automated-trigger/drift` metric and warning log on every 3-hour run, for each deleted workflow with a trigger, until the rows are destroyed. Fix: add `WHERE "deletedAt" IS NULL` to this query.
